notes: Reconciled from blind labelers A and B. Both gave the same 6 outer-skin pairs, and no disagreement remained after checking. Real mesh scan: both skins scanned 1.92 mm apart, plane rms 0.01-0.06 mm. Part frame: x along the long base fold, y from back wall to front wall, z up from the base. The part is a tray: a base (3 outer / 4 inner, 106 x 76 mm) with three walls bent up from it: a tall back wall 1/2, which overhangs the base by about 71 mm in +x; a tall front wall 5/8; and a low end wall 6/7 (about 26 mm tall). Three 23 mm mounting tabs are folded inward at the wall tops: 11/13 and 12/9 on the back wall, 10 on the front wall. Perpendicular sections show concentric rounded 90 deg arcs (outer R about 3.8 mm, inner about 1.9 mm) at all 6 joints: yz cuts at x=-50/0/20 for the base folds, xz cuts at y=-28.5/-20/10/40/46.5 for the end wall, and yz cuts through each tab. The end wall's two vertical corners with the side walls are not folds. Horizontal cuts at z=-10/0/7 show a sharp outer corner (r<0.5 mm), no inner arc, and a 0.2 mm seam step: butt/closed corners. Above the end wall, the side-wall cut ends are coplanar with face 6. The back-wall overhang (x 46..117) is flat plate with a free bottom edge. No unlabeled point lies more than 2.9 mm from a patch; the points beyond 2.5 mm are fold-arc middles only. Mixed-skin and inner-twin candidates are duplicates of these 6.

bends.note: Base to back wall, outer skins (3 = base underside, 1 = back wall outer face). Rounded 90 deg fold along the base's full length, about 106 mm, from the end-wall corner to the base's free end at x of about 46. The back wall continues past it as a flat overhang.
Base to front wall, outer skins. Rounded 90 deg fold of about 87 mm, from the end-wall corner to the front wall's end at x of about 26. Beyond that, the base edge is free.

Base to low end wall, outer skins. Rounded 90 deg fold of about 75-78 mm between the side walls' inner faces. The end wall's corners with walls 1 and 5 are butt seams, not bends. Patch 6 also takes in the side walls' coplanar cut-end faces, so check the extent.
Inward mounting tab at the top of the back wall, near the end wall (x of about -50..-27). Outer skin = back wall outer face 1 + tab top 11. 13 is the tab's inner twin.
Inward mounting tab at the top of the back wall's overhang (x of about 80..103). Outer skin = back wall outer face 1 + tab top 12. 9 is the tab's inner twin.
Inward mounting tab at the top of the front wall (x of about -3..20). Outer skin = front wall outer face 5 + tab top 10. The tab underside is not segmented.
